settings.name: Power_Limit
settings.label: Power limit
settings.description: Discharge power limit sent to the inverter (the window limit with the moving-window limiter). Can only be lowered below the built-in value

settings.name: Discharge_Current_Limit
settings.label: Discharge current limit
settings.description: Inverter DC current limit before derating. The AMS trip stays at the built-in value

settings.name: Temp_Limit
settings.label: Temperature limit
settings.description: Hottest cell at which both inverter limits are fully derated (discharge to 25 A, regen to 25 A). Lowering it moves both derating ramps down by the same amount. The AMS over-temperature trip is not changed

settings.name: Regen_Enabled
settings.label: Regen
settings.description: 0 = off (0 A brake current to the inverter), 1 = on

settings.name: Regen_Current_Limit
settings.label: Regen current limit
settings.description: Inverter DC brake current limit before derating

settings.name: Charge_Voltage
settings.label: Charge voltage
settings.description: Charger voltage setpoint (pack voltage at the end of charge)
